About the Project
Overview

A fully responsive landing page designed for Hancock Day School — Savannah's only independent, nonsectarian PreK–8 school. The design communicates academic excellence, community, and character across both desktop and mobile experiences.

The page features a hero section, school pillars, photo gallery, enrollment details, affordability section, testimonials, and a tour request form — all crafted to convert prospective families into campus visitors.
